race.description: Pelican Waters Resort Up To 2 Wins Pace
race.comment: CALL KELLY (9) finished second last start, beaten 20 metres at this track over 2040m. Talented and has plenty of upside. May just need a bit of luck at some point from this difficult draw. Beautifully placed and is sure to play a major role. NUMBER ONE RANGER (6) ran fourth last start at this track over 2040m, beaten 21 metres. Talented and has plenty of upside. Has ability and should be right in the finish. HEZA DIRTY DANCER (7) resumes from a spell. Last appeared when a modest ninth over 1660m at Albion Park five months ago. WAIT WHAT (1) is worth another chance after a last-start seventh over 1660m at Albion Park two weeks ago.
